scope: 503 existing JS checks (85 affected lifecycle/language/haptics checks rerun after lifecycle changes, counted once); 25 real Chromium/IndexedDB and controlled-transport checks cover byte-bounded request splitting, display paragraphs, reversed fades/springs, original node identity, per-book switches, restart, continuous/paged/landscape, partial-cache reuse, in-flight deduplication, custom context, MyMemory, late results and background resume; 29 existing Chromium rail/progress/translation regressions; 20 existing generated-EPUB/139k-character reader checks. An initial test fixture reused a book with translations already enabled; its failed log is retained and setup corrected without relaxing assertions. Native code only changes the versioned asset URL. Translation transports are mocked; no paid external requests were made

limits.temporaryChunkCache: Completed chunks retained for interrupted work; atomic cleanup after complete paragraph persistence

limitations: Sentence/length/newline heuristics do not identify every semantic topic transition. Punctuation-free display text is preserved rather than forcibly split.
Native PDF has no OCR/text translation. This feature applies to EPUB/TXT.
Actual Android WebView rendering/touch/IME, physical Redmi K80 Pro FPS and real translation-provider connectivity were not tested; Chromium uses controlled transport.
